title: Vision evidence from a local Qwen VLM makes correction-LLM repair beat numeric-only repair (development-only E10 pilot)
hypothesis: Adding a validated visual failure analysis (Qwen VL on the five rule-selected frames of the parent's worst <=3 failed screen episodes, merged with the numbers by lares.vision.merge) to the Stage F numeric evidence packet lets the correction LLM localise the failing component, so its repairs win more held-out episodes than the identical numeric-only arm at the same repair-episode cap.

prediction.against: arm llm_numeric in the same cell: same structure, same independent data/split/probe bundle and fitting seed, same common preprocessing, acceptance rule, repair-episode cap and held-out cases (pool seed 2629); no_repair reported as a second control
prediction.rationale: Stage F LLM arms were flat and only intervention evidence produced LLM wins, so richer localising evidence is the open lever. 0.05 is a practical target, not a significance cutoff. Uncertainty is a paired t over the 9 independent cells (3 frozen Stage F structures x 3 bundles), with sensitivity to paired held-out-case resampling reported. Tied success is not improvement.

falsified_by: Upper 95% bound of vision-minus-numeric paired success below 0.05 refutes the target magnitude; at or below zero refutes positive added value; an interval including zero is inconclusive about direction. Frame-citation and geometry-consistency audits are made without consulting held-out outcomes; rejected or empty packets stay in the assigned-arm analysis. If most packets carry no valid visual evidence, the localisation mechanism is inconclusive. Vision vs no_repair is reported separately. No expansion after seeing results; an inconclusive pilot needs a separately specified confirmation sized from its paired variance.

result.notes: Nine cells (3 Stage F structures x independent bundles 2620-2628), held-out pool 2629, frozen at 53b36f5 with a clean worktree on the GPU box. All 18 LLM repairs (9 numeric, 9 vision) were rejected by the acceptance rule: every child scored below or equal to its preprocessed parent on the screen, so all three arms are identical on held-out success (0.440) and the primary difference is exactly 0 [0, 0], 0/0/9; case resampling [0, 0]. The vision mechanism was exercised: all 9 packets carried valid analyses (23 returned, 0 rejected, 3 stage conflicts with the geometry). Descriptive only: vision children's screen success averaged 0.322 vs 0.311 for numeric children (paired +0.011; 7 ties, 2 wins, 1 loss at the 10-case screen). Cost per vision arm: 43 repair-evaluation episodes (3 more than numeric, the media reruns) and ~14.0k LLM tokens vs 13.3k; 2 correction-LLM calls per arm. VLM: Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct@cc59489, NF4 language weights, fp16 compute, 7.55 GiB peak on the T4, ~13 s per analysis. Fixes made before the freeze (all in the frozen commit): prompt v2 lists the shown frame ids; non-JSON replies are rejected not raised; MetaWorld offscreen frames are flipped upright. Limitation: at camera 2 the puck occupies few pixels; the smoke analysis misread the stage, so the visual evidence may be weak rather than absent.

verdicts.reasoning: Vision minus numeric held-out success over 9 independent cells is +0.000 [+0.000, +0.000], 0/0/9; held-out case resampling [0, 0]. Upper bound <= 0 refutes positive added value by the predeclared rule. The mechanism was exercised (9/9 packets with valid analyses, 23 returned, 0 rejected), so this is not a null from empty packets. The reason both arms tie no_repair is that all 18 LLM children, after the identical refit, scored at or below their parent on the screen and were rejected; vision children were only marginally better on the screen (+0.011 paired, descriptive). The bottleneck is the quality of the correction LLM's structural edit, not the evidence it is shown; this matches Stage F and R-005.
verdicts.next_experiment: Stop adding evidence to the correction LLM. Either test whether any LLM edit survives refit (e.g. accept on a larger screen, or let the LLM propose only parameter-range/initial-value changes), or redirect effort to parameter search, which led Stage F at no LLM cost.

verdicts.reasoning: The named numeric-only control was measured: paired_success_difference was 0.000, with paired t95 and held-out-case bootstrap intervals both [0.000, 0.000] [logs/stage_f_vision/20261022_072119/summary.json]. The upper bound is below the predicted 0.05 improvement, refuting the target magnitude; the tie is not evidence of a directional advantage [logs/stage_f_vision/20261022_072119/summary.json]. All three arms achieved 0.440 held-out success, with every cell retaining its parent rather than accepting a repair [logs/stage_f_vision/20261022_072119/summary.json].
